From Chocolate Disco · Price: only inside a grid you drew beforehand.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 minute: draw a 30-ft grid. 1 action: teleport an unattended object in the grid to another square in it.
  • 5: You can teleport an attended object (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates).
  • 9: Surge: teleport a falling or thrown object onto a creature's square: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}).
  • 13: Teleport yourself within the grid.
  • 17: Teleport a creature within the grid (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
